acquisition_suppression_target.name: acquisition_suppression_target
acquisition_suppression_target.value: length(trim("acquisition_suppression_entries"."target")) between 3 and 254 and ("acquisition_suppression_entries"."kind" <> 'DOMAIN' or ("acquisition_suppression_entries"."target" = lower("acquisition_suppression_entries"."target") and "acquisition_suppression_entries"."target" not like '%@%')) and ("acquisition_suppression_entries"."kind" <> 'EMAIL' or "acquisition_suppression_entries"."target" ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+$')

discovery_candidate_bounds.name: discovery_candidate_bounds
discovery_candidate_bounds.value: "acquisition_discovery_candidates"."position" between 1 and 20 and length(trim("acquisition_discovery_candidates"."name")) between 1 and 160 and length(trim("acquisition_discovery_candidates"."name_key")) between 1 and 160 and "acquisition_discovery_candidates"."country" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' and "acquisition_discovery_candidates"."version" >= 0 and "acquisition_discovery_candidates"."fingerprint" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

discovery_candidate_domain.name: discovery_candidate_domain
discovery_candidate_domain.value: "acquisition_discovery_candidates"."domain" = lower("acquisition_discovery_candidates"."domain") and "acquisition_discovery_candidates"."domain" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$' and "acquisition_discovery_candidates"."domain" not like '%..%' and ("acquisition_discovery_candidates"."domain" like '%.example' or "acquisition_discovery_candidates"."domain" like '%.test' or "acquisition_discovery_candidates"."domain" ~ '(^|[.])example[.](com|org|net)$')

discovery_review_decision.name: discovery_review_decision
discovery_review_decision.value: "acquisition_discovery_reviews"."version" > 0 and "acquisition_discovery_reviews"."decision" in ('APPROVE','REJECT','SUPPRESS','DUPLICATE','NEEDS_EVIDENCE','RESOLVE_DISTINCT') and ("acquisition_discovery_reviews"."finding_id" is not null) = ("acquisition_discovery_reviews"."decision" in ('DUPLICATE','RESOLVE_DISTINCT'))
